notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
